title: The h7 trap
intro: In the opening, h7 (or h2) is guarded only by the king. When a knight and a queen both aim at it, one careless move loses at once.

lessons.title: Mate on h7
lessons.summary: Queen and knight against the castled king.

steps.text: White's knight on g5 and queen on c2 both aim at h7. Black's knight left f6, the square that usually guards h7, so now only the king defends it.

steps.hint: Two white pieces attack h7 and only the king defends it.
steps.ifWrong: Take on h7: the knight protects your queen there.
steps.ifRight: Checkmate. Keep a knight on f6 (or f3) while queen and knight aim at h7.

steps.text: Here the queen and a rook line up on h7. Find the mate.
steps.hint: The queen on c2 reaches h7 along the diagonal, and your rook on h1 backs it up from behind.
steps.ifWrong: Look at the diagonal from c2 to h7.
steps.ifRight: Mate on h7 again. When your knight leaves f6, check what guards h7.
